english.note: Use this for a small flowering or berry-bearing branch, rather than a whole bouquet.

examples.english: That flower stall has some lovely spray of flowers, so I bought one to put in a small vase.
examples.traditional: 花墟嗰檔有啲靚花枝，我買返去插喺細樽度。
